title: Animals Worksheets | K–1st Science Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Standards aligned: 1-LS1-1, K-ESS3-1, K-LS1-1

Give your learners extra practice with Animals! This no-prep printable pack has 4 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (7 pages)

  • Cover page

  • Fur, Feathers or Scales?
  • Land, Water or Sky?
  • Which One Can Fly?
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (What Does It Say?, Fur, Feathers or Scales?, Land, Water or Sky?, Which One Can Fly?), so children can play, then print and practice
